```
def process_text(inline: 'InlineParser', text: str, state: 'InlineState'
    ) ->None:
    ref_abbrs = state.env.get('ref_abbrs')
    if not ref_abbrs:
        inline.tokens.append({'type': 'text', 'raw': text, 'children': None})
        return

    # Build a pattern that matches any of the abbreviation keys
    # Sort by length (longest first) to handle overlapping abbreviations
    keys = sorted(ref_abbrs.keys(), key=len, reverse=True)
    pattern = r'(?<!\w)(' + '|'.join(re.escape(key) for key in keys) + r')(?!\w)'

    pos = 0
    for m in re.finditer(pattern, text):
        start, end = m.start(), m.end()
        if start > pos:
            inline.tokens.append({'type': 'text', 'raw': text[pos:start], 'children': None})
        key = m.group(1)
        title = ref_abbrs.get(key, '')
        inline.tokens.append({'type': 'abbr', 'children': key, 'attrs': {'title': title}})
        pos = end

    if pos < len(text):
        inline.tokens.append({'type': 'text', 'raw': text[pos:], 'children': None})
